import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *

def one_req(wire, peer="edge", auth="alice", eg="external", t=0):
    return envelope([ev(t, peer, auth, eg, h(wire) if isinstance(wire, (str, bytes)) else wire)])

def reason_of(wire, peer="edge", auth="alice", eg="external"):
    rc, out, err = run(one_req(wire, peer, auth, eg))
    if rc != 0:
        return ("EXIT", rc)
    r = json.loads(out)
    return r["results"][0].get("reason", r["results"][0]["decision"])

def expect_reason(name, wire, want, **kw):
    got = reason_of(wire, **kw)
    expect(name, got == want, f"want={want} got={got}")

G = mkreq(headers=std_headers())   # good request

# hex stage
expect_reason("hex odd", "4d4", "hex")
expect_reason("hex bad char", "4m", "hex")
expect_reason("hex empty", "", "syntax")
expect_reason("hex uppercase", G.hex().upper(), "accept")
expect_reason("hex lowercase", G.hex(), "accept")

# syntax stage
expect_reason("no delimiter", b"MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: x", "syntax")
expect_reason("bare LF", mkreq(headers=std_headers()).replace(b"\r\n", b"\n"), "syntax")
expect_reason("bare CR", b"MESSAGE a SIP/2.0\rFrom: b\r\n\r\n", "syntax")
expect_reason("lone CR mid line", b"MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0\rA\rB\r\n\r\n", "syntax")
expect_reason("lone LF mid line", b"MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0\rA\nB\r\n\r\n", "syntax")
expect_reason("DEL byte", b"MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0\r\nX: \x7f\r\n\r\n", "syntax")
expect_reason("non-ascii header", b"MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0\r\nX: \xff\r\n\r\n", "syntax")
expect_reason("NUL in header", b"MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0\r\nX: \x00\r\n\r\n", "syntax")
expect_reason("body NUL ok", mkreq(headers=std_headers(), body=b"a\x00b"), "accept")
expect_reason("body crlfcrlf ok", mkreq(headers=std_headers(), body=b"a\r\n\r\nb"), "accept")
expect_reason("body fake headers ok", mkreq(headers=std_headers(), body=b"From: evil\r\n\r\n"), "accept")
expect_reason("only first delimiter splits", mkreq(headers=std_headers(), body=b"\r\n\r\nX: y"), "accept")

# start line
expect_reason("method lowercase", mkreq(startline="message sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0", headers=std_headers()), "syntax")
expect_reason("method ACK", mkreq(startline="ACK sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0", headers=std_headers()), "syntax")
expect_reason("method REGISTER", mkreq(startline="REGISTER sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0", headers=std_headers()), "syntax")
expect_reason("bad version", mkreq(startline="MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.1", headers=std_headers()), "syntax")
expect_reason("version lowercase", mkreq(startline="MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test sip/2.0", headers=std_headers()), "syntax")
expect_reason("tab separator", mkreq(startline="MESSAGE\tsip:bob@lab.test\tSIP/2.0", headers=std_headers()), "syntax")
expect_reason("double space", mkreq(startline="MESSAGE  sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0", headers=std_headers()), "syntax")
expect_reason("trailing space sl", mkreq(startline="MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0 ", headers=std_headers()), "syntax")
expect_reason("leading space sl", mkreq(startline=" MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0", headers=std_headers()), "syntax")
expect_reason("tel target", mkreq(startline="MESSAGE tel:+12025550100 SIP/2.0", headers=std_headers()), "syntax")
expect_reason("bad target uri", mkreq(startline="MESSAGE sip:bob@lab SIP/2.0", headers=std_headers()), "syntax")
expect_reason("target with params", mkreq(startline="MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test;transport=udp SIP/2.0", headers=std_headers()), "syntax")
expect_reason("target sips ok", mkreq(startline="MESSAGE sips:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0", headers=[("From","sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t"),("To","sips:bob@lab.test"),("Call-ID","demo"),("CSeq","7 MESSAGE"),("Content-Length","0")]), "accept")
expect_reason("INVITE ok", mkreq(method="INVITE", headers=[("From","sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t"),("To","sip:bob@lab.test"),("Call-ID","demo"),("CSeq","7 INVITE"),("Content-Length","0")]), "accept")

# header generic syntax
expect_reason("no colon", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + ["Broken-line-no-colon"]), "syntax")
expect_reason("empty name", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + [": x"]), "syntax")
expect_reason("name with space inside", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + ["Bad Name: x"]), "syntax")
expect_reason("name with tab inside", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + ["Bad\tName: x"]), "syntax")
expect_reason("name OWS before colon ok", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + ["X-Note  :  y  "]), "accept")
expect_reason("continuation first header", mkreq(headers=["\tcontinued"] + std_headers()), "syntax")
expect_reason("continuation ok", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + ["X-Note: part1", "\tpart2"]), "accept")
expect_reason("unknown header empty value", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + ["X-Empty:"]), "accept")
expect_reason("unknown header empty value sp", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + ["X-Empty:   "]), "accept")

# size limits
expect_reason("line too long", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + [("X-Long", "a" * 8189)]), "syntax")  # "X-Long: " + 8189 = 8196 > 8192
expect_reason("line exactly 8192", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + [("X-Long", "a" * 8185)]), "accept")  # 7 + 8185 = 8192
hdr257 = std_headers() + [("X-H%d" % i, "v") for i in range(253)]
expect_reason("256 headers ok", mkreq(headers=hdr257), "accept")
hdr258 = std_headers() + [("X-H%d" % i, "v") for i in range(254)]
expect_reason("257 headers", mkreq(headers=hdr258), "syntax")
# header block > 32768
big_hdrs = std_headers() + [("X-B%d" % i, "y" * 200) for i in range(200)]
expect_reason("header block big", mkreq(headers=big_hdrs), "syntax")
# decoded > 65536 -> not reachable via wire_hex limit; check header block boundary
hb32k = std_headers() + [("X-K", "z" * 32700)]
expect_reason("hb too big", mkreq(headers=hb32k), "syntax")

# headers stage (missing / duplicate singletons)
for miss in ["From", "To", "Call-ID", "CSeq", "Content-Length"]:
    hs = [x for x in std_headers() if x[0] != miss]
    expect_reason(f"missing {miss}", mkreq(headers=hs), "headers")
expect_reason("dup From", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + [("From", "sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t")]), "headers")
expect_reason("dup From compact", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + [("f", "sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t")]), "headers")
expect_reason("dup From identical", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + [("FROM", "sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t")]), "headers")
expect_reason("dup CSeq", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + [("cseq", "7 MESSAGE")]), "headers")
expect_reason("dup Content-Length compact", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + [("l", "0")]), "headers")
expect_reason("dup Call-ID compact i", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + [("i", "demo")]), "headers")
expect_reason("dup To compact t", mkreq(headers=std_headers() + [("t", "sip:bob@lab.test")]), "headers")

# length stage
expect_reason("cl not digits", mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=b"abc"), cl="abc"), "length")
expect_reason("cl empty", mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=b"abc"), cl=""), "length")
expect_reason("cl too many digits", mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=b"abc"), cl="00000000003"), "length")
expect_reason("cl 10 digits ok", mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=b"abc"), cl="0000000003"), "accept")
expect_reason("cl mismatch short", mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=b"abc"), cl="2"), "length")
expect_reason("cl mismatch long", mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=b"abc"), cl="4"), "length")
expect_reason("cl leading zeros ok", mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=b"abc"), cl="003"), "accept")
expect_reason("cl space padded", mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=b"abc"), cl=" 3 "), "accept")
expect_reason("cl plus sign", mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=b"abc"), cl="+3"), "length")
expect_reason("cl zero body", mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=b""), cl="0"), "accept")
summary()
